Title: Name changes: Virtual Machines B-series US Gov

Body.Content:
Create scalable and reliable apps and APIs—that are inexpensive to operate—with Azure Cloud Services. Focus on your apps and not maintaining hardware. Deploy apps by using any language you like, including Java, Node.js, PHP, Python, .NET, or Ruby.

Azure Virtual Machines B-series naming will change on May 1, 2018, in all Azure Government regions. The letters “VM” will be removed from all Cloud Services B-series names. We’re making this change to standardize names across all VM types. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you might need to modify billing routines that rely on the new names.

 

See the following table for name changes:
